fact_text: Mobilink Bank is a microfinance bank that has operated in Pakistan since 2012, and it runs JazzCash, which the CEO described as the country's largest payment system.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Mobilink Bank's products are microloans, deposits and insurance, including crop insurance that the bank had only just started, plus life and non-life insurance products.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Mobilink Bank's CEO said the bank focuses on rural and remote areas, where microfinance need is greatest, while commercial banks concentrate in metropolitan areas and serve affluent customers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said Mobilink Bank wants to be a digital microfinance bank but expects branches to remain for some time, so it is pursuing a hybrid model with fewer staff per branch and more self-service machines.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Mobilink Bank's branches used to have eight or 10 staff doing different tasks; the CEO said the bank is cutting staff per branch and adding cash deposit machines and other digital touchpoints.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO estimated that about 35% of Pakistan's population is unbanked, meaning they have no bank account; the underbanked have an account but no microfinance or other usable product.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said commercial banks have about 4 million borrowers in total, a very small base against Pakistan's population and income levels.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said commercial banks have about 2.2 million credit card customers, a figure he gave as part of the small share of the population using bank credit products.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan has only about 40,000 mortgage or home loans, which he cited as a very small share of the population.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said small farmers and livestock businesses, which he linked to agriculture, represent about 28% of Pakistan's GDP.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said commercial banks largely do not lend to small and medium enterprises in Pakistan's undocumented economy, a gap Mobilink wants to fill, and he described SME credit demand as very large.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said Mobilink revisited its strategy and also supports small businesses in urban areas, while keeping its original focus on agriculture and livestock lending in rural areas.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said Mobilink does not require a polished business plan; it asks what the borrower wants to do and how they will repay, and checks whether the borrower has a physical presence in the area.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said consumption loans, such as for education or a wedding, carry a higher risk of non-repayment than productive loans, so the bank tries to confirm the loan will fund productive use.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: For farm and livestock loans, the CEO said the bank checks whether the borrower owns the animals, such as buffaloes or cows, and the land, and whether the loan buys fertilizer or supports modern farming.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Floods in 2022 and 2023 hit the agriculture-heavy belts of South Punjab and interior Sindh, wiping out crops and making loan repayment harder for farmers and livestock borrowers, the CEO said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said climate change is an ongoing risk for Mobilink's agricultural lending, which makes up much of its rural loan book, and that the bank's purpose is still to support small farmers and businesses.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said most microfinance loans are unsecured; some borrowers pledge household gold or a tractor, but an agri passbook is not a collateral the bank can realise in practice.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said microfinance rates are higher than commercial bank rates because the lender takes most of the credit risk and its cost of doing business is also higher.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Mobilink's nano loans are small digital loans offered through the JazzCash app to its payment customers, with an average ticket of about Rs 4,000.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Nano loan tenors run from one day up to about 30 to 40 days, and borrowers typically keep them for roughly 5 to 10 days, according to the CEO.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Mobilink calls the nano loan charge a fee, not markup or interest; the CEO said it is quoted on an annual basis, so the headline looks high for loans that last only days.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO gave nano loans as working-capital examples: a shopkeeper borrows in the morning to buy stock and repays by evening, and a delivery or ride-hailing driver borrows to fund fuel for the day.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Before formal nano loans, borrowers often used informal moneylenders who charged far higher rates and, the CEO said, damaged borrowers' dignity through humiliation and threats to families.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan's private sector lending is around 14-15% of GDP, below 20%, far under Indonesia and Malaysia at about 45-50% and China near 100%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Interest rates rose sharply in the years before the 2025 interview, and the CEO said they were falling as stability returns, hoping they will drop further into single digits.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said the microfinance industry's non-performing loans are around 10%, up from roughly 5-6% before COVID-19 and sometimes as low as about 4%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO attributed the higher microfinance NPLs to COVID-19, which hit rural businesses, and the 2022 and 2023 floods in farming belts, and he called the rise temporary as rates fall.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said the Mobilink group invested USD 15 million in the microfinance bank to support its growth and its digitisation drive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said microfinance banks are not run to maximise profit or pay large shareholder dividends, but to build a lasting impact on the economy, a purpose-driven model.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said telecom is among the most heavily taxed sectors in the region and possibly among the top three globally, and that taxes on telecom services are a burden on consumers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan's average revenue per user (ARPU) for telecom is very low, possibly among the lowest in the region and globally, which limits operator returns on infrastructure.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Telecom spectrum licences, such as 4G and future 5G, are paid to government in dollars, while operators earn revenue in rupees, so a sharp dollar rise squeezes operators and slows network expansion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said about 35% of Pakistanis still have no 4G access, and less than 5% have broadband, so the sector has a large build-out ahead.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan's optical fibre network is weak, likely because operators find infrastructure costs high relative to low returns, and fibre is the highway a digital economy runs on.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said taxes on telecom usage also raise the cost of e-education and tele-health, which he argued are needed because hospitals cannot serve the whole population and policy should weigh which sectors are taxed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO cited 22 to 25 million children out of school in Pakistan, with about 65 to 70% of them girls.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said Pakistan has only about 3 to 4 million taxpayers, a very small base for its population, and a tax-to-GDP share he also called very small.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Ahead of the FY26 budget, the CEO said telecom companies were in talks with government and hoped taxes on telecom services would be reduced, while sectors not yet taxed should be brought into the tax net.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Mobilink runs WIN, a women's programme that offers financial and digital literacy training, subsidised loans, and a women's incubation centre that mentors and funds female entrepreneurs.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said the absolute gender gap in financial inclusion in Pakistan is 14%, and that women make up about half the population.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: The CEO said only about 3% of women in Pakistan receive their rightful inheritance, based on data Mobilink gathered for an awareness campaign on the topic.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)

fact_text: Mobilink's app includes an inheritance calculator that lets a woman enter her relatives and estate to work out her exact share, which the CEO said he did not know any other microfinance or commercial bank offering.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Mobilink Bank CEO on Financial Inclusion, Innovation & the Road Ahead | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-05-16)
